runtime_limitations: E3 model load is included in inference_seconds; separate load timing was not recorded.
E3 CPU scoring/evaluation is combined; historical read/cleanup/components/baselines timings were not recorded.
E3 process peak RSS is a cumulative process high-water mark, not per-case allocation.
E4 CPU timings are new analysis measurements, not a replay or estimate of E3 overhead.
summary.analysis_role: secondary_sensitivity_and_qualitative; E3 primary method and decision unchanged

report_corrections.scope: report-only schema repair; no inference, scoring, bootstrap or selection rerun

limits: Added after inspection of held-out results; exploratory, no E3 primary change.
Fixed budgets remain bone-based; expected reviewed CT costs are descriptive point estimates.
Random is the expected random-ranking risk, not a sampled random-order simulation.
CIs are marginal percentile intervals; no familywise confirmatory claims.
No new policy/QC gate or inference; no change to historical timing measurements.

metadata.uncertainty: individual trajectories and median only; no CI

provenance_limit.interpretation: Run-bound hashes verified; chronology is not an independent registration proof.

verification_scope: Recorded report/cache/code hashes and table extraction, not raw-volume/checkpoint rereading.
